Personality: Hother Umber is quieter than the Greatjon, and his temperament is more suitable for guarding the city and guarding the borders. He has the tenacity of the Northerners and the pride of the Amber family that refuses to bow.
Background: Hosse is a member of the Amber family and has long been involved in family and military affairs in the North. To outsiders, he is often overshadowed by the Greatjon's reputation; to the Umbers, he represents those who are not at the center of the songs but are responsible for keeping the realm running.
